title: JSON, YAML and Kiro configuration checklist

items.question: Does every key and value follow the documented format for this file (for Kiro files, the kiro.dev docs page)?
Are paths, globs and command names correct relative to where the tool reads them?
Do permissions and tool lists grant only what the role or step needs?
Are version numbers, schema versions and IDs consistent with the code that reads this file?
Is the file free of secrets, machine-specific absolute paths and ignored-folder rules for .kiro/?
